tools.name: get_mail_item
tools.description: Get an overview of the current mail item: subject, sender, recipients (to/cc/bcc), date, and item type (read or compose).

tools.name: get_mail_body
tools.description: Get the full body content of the current mail item as HTML or plain text.

format.description: Body format to retrieve. Defaults to "text".

tools.name: get_mail_attachments
tools.description: List all attachments on the current mail item with name, size, and content type. Does not download attachment content.

tools.name: get_attachment_content
tools.description: Get the content of a specific attachment by index. Returns base64-encoded data for file attachments or item details for item attachments.

index.description: Zero-based index of the attachment to retrieve.

tools.name: set_mail_body
tools.description: Set or replace the body content of the current mail item. Only works in compose mode. Supports HTML or plain text.

tools.name: set_mail_subject
tools.description: Set the subject of the current mail item. Only works in compose mode.

tools.name: add_mail_recipient
tools.description: Add one or more recipients to the current mail item. Only works in compose mode. Specify the field (to, cc, or bcc).

tools.name: reply_to_mail
tools.description: Create a reply to the current mail item with the given HTML content. Only works in read mode. Use replyAll to reply to all recipients.

htmlBody.description: HTML content for the reply body.

replyAll.description: If true, reply to all recipients. Defaults to false.

tools.name: forward_mail
tools.description: Open a forward form for the current mail item with optional HTML content pre-filled. Only works in read mode.

htmlBody.description: Optional HTML content to prepend to the forwarded message.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get the current mailbox user profile information (name, email, time zone).

tools.name: add_file_attachment
tools.description: Add a file attachment to the current mail item by URL. Only works in compose mode. The file is downloaded from the URL by Outlook.

uri.description: The URL of the file to attach.

tools.name: remove_attachment
tools.description: Remove an attachment from the current mail item by its attachment ID. Only works in compose mode.

attachmentId.description: The ID of the attachment to remove.

tools.name: get_mail_categories
tools.description: Get the categories (color labels) assigned to the current mail item.

tools.name: set_mail_categories
tools.description: Add categories (color labels) to the current mail item. Categories must be in the master category list.

categories.description: Array of category names to add.

tools.name: remove_mail_categories
tools.description: Remove categories from the current mail item.

categories.description: Array of category names to remove.

tools.name: add_notification
tools.description: Show an informational notification banner on the current mail item. The notification appears at the top of the reading pane or compose form.

key.description: Unique key to identify this notification (for later removal).

persistent.description: If true, notification persists until removed. Defaults to false.

tools.name: remove_notification
tools.description: Remove a previously shown notification banner by its key.

key.description: The key of the notification to remove.

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Save the current compose item as a draft. Only works in compose mode.

tools.name: get_mail_headers
tools.description: Get internet message headers of the current mail item including Message-ID, conversation ID, and item ID.

tools.name: display_new_message
tools.description: Open a new message compose form with optional pre-filled fields (to, cc, subject, body).

toRecipients.description: Array of email addresses for the To field.

ccRecipients.description: Array of email addresses for the CC field.

subject.description: Subject line for the new message.

htmlBody.description: HTML body content for the new message.

tools.name: display_new_appointment
tools.description: Open a new appointment/meeting form with optional pre-filled fields (attendees, subject, body, start/end times, location).

requiredAttendees.description: Array of email addresses for required attendees.

optionalAttendees.description: Array of email addresses for optional attendees.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Get diagnostic information about the Outlook host (host name, version, platform).
